# Design: Saga-Workspace UX + Permission Bundles + Lobby

<!-- generated by /pingpong-solution on 2026-10-12 -->

## Problem & Intent

Der Saga-Workspace (`/sagas/SA-…`) zeigt eine volle Nav, liefert aber Stubs (Charaktere/NSC/Items/Quests), eine Look-only-Welt, Overview-Crash durch fehlende `session_recaps`, und einen Session-Create-Zwischenscreen statt direkter Lobby. Dornhain muss als vollständiges Lern-Abenteuer wirken (gleiche Oberflächen wie eine User-Saga). Berechtigungen später saga-scoped über **Permission-Bundles** (Browo-HR-Muster): keine festen Rollen-Checks — nur Permission-Keys; Bundles sind Zuweisungs-Shortcuts.

**Success:** Workspace-Tabs funktionieren mit Library-gefilterten Daten + Create; Welt = Karten/Locations/Lore; neuer Tab **Lore / Verlauf**; Session-Create → sofort Lobby mit großem Join-Code; Dornhain-Seed füllt alle Lern-Assets; Permission-Catalog + 2 Default-Bundles (GM / Spieler) in Settings.

## Non-Goals

- Kein Port des gesamten Browo-HR Admin-UI
- Keine festen Rollen (`if role === 'gm'`) im neuen Product-Code — Legacy `project_members.role` / `is_project_gm` nur bis Migration/Compat
- Kein Editieren von `origin=native` System-Zeilen durch Clients (immutable)
- Kein volles Scriptony-Feature-Parity in einem Ticket — Scope in Phasen

## Assumptions (confirmed)

1. Saga-Tabs = **Filter derselben Library-Daten** auf diese Saga; Create landet in Library und erscheint in der Saga.
2. **Welt** = Weltkarten + Locations + Lore (Scriptony-Stil); Look-Default → Settings.
3. Dornhain = vollständiger Katalog (PCs, Welt, NSCs, Items, Quests) als System-Lernsaga.
4. Session-Create → **direkt Lobby**; Lobby = Prepare; Code primär groß + Copy/Einladung; kein Countdown-Interstitial.
5. **Keine festen Rollen** — nur Permissions; Bundles beschleunigen Zuweisung. Wer Permission X hat, darf X — auch ohne GM-Bundle.
6. Default Spieler-Bundle: **ganze Party** sehen.
7. Katalog-Sichtbarkeit: Spieler ohne Secrets sehen nur **`party` (revealed)**; `gm_only` braucht Secrets/Read-Hidden.
8. Mutate (Items/NSC/…) wenn Permission vorhanden.
9. Saga-Creator bekommt automatisch **GM-Bundle**; immer ≥1 Member mit Governance (`saga.members.set_bundle`); GM kann anderem GM-Bundle geben.
10. Bis Settings live: beide Bundles ≈ gleicher Grant **außer** `saga.secrets.*` + `saga.members.set_bundle` (nur Creator/GM-Bundle).
11. Native Dornhain: **immutable** — Client liest/nutzt; Edits = saga-/user-owned Kopien/Overlays.
12. Nav bekommt Tab **Lore / Verlauf** (Session-Wissen / Entdeckungen / Recap-Verlauf) — getrennt vom Katalog-Reveal.

## Research

- Codebase: `SagaResourceScreen` stubs (`UNAVAILABLE_COPY`); `WorldLookPreviewPanel` auf `world`; `SessionJoin` 2s auto-nav; Lobby hat `summary.code` aber oft `Session not found in saga`; migrations `048` session knowledge, `061` session_recaps.
- Browo-HR: `docs/permissions.catalog.yaml` — flat keys + named bundles as assignment templates.
- Helpers: pingpong + ux-design-laws (Hick: eine Primary-Action; Peak-End: Lobby als Abschluss Create; Serial: Code zuerst in Lobby).

---

## Options Considered

### Option A: Permission-first Bundles + Workspace fill + Lobby cut-through (recommended)

- Summary: Catalog `saga.*` keys; bundles `bundle.saga.gm` / `bundle.saga.player`; workspace sections real (reuse Library browsers scoped); reveal on saga bindings; Lore/Verlauf tab; strip create interstitial; apply missing migrations.
- Pros: Matches product intent; Browo pattern; no fake roles; Dornhain teachable.
- Cons: Multi-phase; needs binding + reveal schema; legacy `is_project_gm` migration path.
- Evidence: User answers 2026-10-12; stubs in `SagaResourceScreen.tsx`; Browo catalog.

### Option B: YAGNI — keep stubs, only fix migrations + lobby nav (rejected as sole delivery)

- Summary: Apply 061+, remove countdown, show code in lobby; leave tabs as „geh zur Bibliothek“.
- Pros: Smallest diff.
- Cons: Workspace bleibt Fake-Cockpit; Dornhain lernt nichts; User-Frustration bleibt.
- Evidence: Screenshots Overview/Characters empty.

### Option C: Hard-code GM/Player role checks forever (rejected)

- Summary: Expand `project_members.role` only.
- Pros: Already in DB.
- Cons: Widerspricht explizitem Bundle-Modell; Spieler mit Extra-Permission bräuchte Role-Hack.

## Decision

**Chosen:** Option A, **phased**.

**Ponytail:** Stop at rung 4–5 for Phase 1 (wire real lists + lobby + migration); Phase 2 catalog/reveal/settings; Phase 3 Dornhain full seed polish. No new npm deps.

## Permission catalog (v1)

Key pattern: `saga.{area}.{action}`

### Keys

| Key | Meaning |
|-----|---------|
| `saga.workspace.access` | Open saga workspace |
| `saga.characters.read` | See party PCs |
| `saga.characters.create` | Create PC (library + saga bind) |
| `saga.characters.update_own` | Edit own PC |
| `saga.characters.update_any` | Edit any PC |
| `saga.characters.assign` | Bind/unbind PC to saga |
| `saga.world.read` | Maps / locations / lore read |
| `saga.world.update` | Edit world content |
| `saga.npc.read` | See `party`-revealed NSCs |
| `saga.npc.read_hidden` | See `gm_only` NSCs |
| `saga.npc.create` / `update` / `delete` | Mutate NSC defs (+ bind) |
| `saga.items.read` / `read_hidden` / `create` / `update` / `delete` | Analog |
| `saga.quests.read` / `read_hidden` / `create` / `update` / `delete` | Analog |
| `saga.lore.read` | Lore / Verlauf tab (party-safe timeline) |
| `saga.lore.read_hidden` | GM notes / unrevealed facts |
| `saga.secrets.read` | Alias group for hidden catalog + lore (or compose from `*_hidden`) |
| `saga.secrets.reveal` | Flip binding `gm_only` ↔ `party` |
| `saga.sessions.create` | Host session |
| `saga.sessions.join` | Join by code |
| `saga.sessions.lobby.manage` | Ready gate, start live, kick from lobby |
| `saga.sessions.invite.copy` | Copy invite / show primary code CTA |
| `saga.sessions.live.run` | GM live surface |
| `saga.sessions.recap.approve` | Approve recap / promote outcomes |
| `saga.members.read` | Member list |
| `saga.members.invite` | Invite flows |
| `saga.members.kick` | Remove member |
| `saga.members.set_bundle` | Assign/revoke bundles (**governance**) |
| `saga.settings.read` / `update` | Saga settings |
| `saga.story.read` / `update` | Story definition (user sagas; native read-only) |

### Bundles

**`bundle.saga.gm`** (creator default): all keys above.

**`bundle.saga.player`** (join default):  
`workspace.access`, `characters.read|create|update_own`, `world.read`, `npc.read`, `items.read`, `quests.read`, `lore.read`, `sessions.join`, `sessions.invite.copy` (optional — only if granted), `members.read`, `settings.read`, `story.read`.  
**Not** by default: `*_hidden`, `secrets.*`, `set_bundle`, `world.update`, `story.update`, `sessions.create`, `lobby.manage`, `live.run`, `recap.approve`, `kick`, mutate keys.

**Transition (Settings not live):** both bundles ≈ full grant **except** `saga.secrets.*` + `saga.members.set_bundle` (only on GM-bundle / creator).

**Invariant:** ≥1 active member holds `saga.members.set_bundle`. Cannot revoke last governance grant.

**Enforcement:** server/RLS/RPC checks permission list on membership — never URL, never nav label. UI hides CTAs without permission (Postel: disable impossible actions).

---

## Reveal model (catalog)

On **saga ↔ asset binding** (not on native catalog row alone):

| Status | Visible to |
|--------|------------|
| `gm_only` | holders of respective `*.read_hidden` / `secrets.read` |
| `party` | holders of `*.read` |
| `unlisted` | not in lists; deep-link / session only |

- Create default: `gm_only`.
- Reveal/Hide: `saga.secrets.reveal`.
- Dornhain seed: starter assets `party`; spoilers `gm_only`.
- Session knowledge (`048`) stays for **live facts**; Lore/Verlauf *reads* that + recaps — separate from catalog reveal.

**Native immutable:** mutations clone/overlay into saga-owned rows; never UPDATE `origin=native` definitions from client.

---

## UX — Workspace Nav

Order (Serial Position + Hick):

1. Übersicht  
2. Spieler-Charaktere *(rename from Charaktere)*  
3. Welt  
4. NSCs / Kreaturen  
5. Gegenstände  
6. Quests  
7. **Lore / Verlauf** *(new — session knowledge, discoveries, episode recaps)*  
8. Sessions  
9. Einstellungen  

**Per section (Laws):** one primary CTA („Hinzufügen“ / „Neue Session“) if `*.create` / `sessions.create`; lists from scoped library query; empty states teach Dornhain completeness.

**Welt:** maps + locations + lore panels first; Look preview link → Settings (Prägnanz: don’t mix Look into Welt primary).

**Lore / Verlauf:** timeline of revealed knowledge + completed episode summaries; hidden facts only with `lore.read_hidden`.

**Einstellungen:** Look default, member list, **bundle assignment** (Phase 2).

---

## UX — Session entry

1. Create session succeeds → **immediate** `navigate` to `/sagas/{SA}/sessions/{SE}/lobby` (no 2s interstitial, no „Session erstellt“ card as destination).
2. Lobby header: **Join-Code groß** + Copy + Einladung (if `sessions.invite.copy` or `lobby.manage`).
3. Lobby = prepare (devices, roster, ready); strip separate prepare hop when coming from create.
4. Fix `getSessionByPublicIds` / meta public ids so Lobby never shows `Session not found in saga` after successful create.

---

Apply missing migrations on live DB (`061` `session_recaps` et al.) — Overview RPCs depend on them. Track in implement Phase 0.

## Cross-Domain Sign-Off

| Domain | Status | Note |
|--------|--------|------|
| KISS | ✅ | Two bundles; permission checks not role matrix |
| SOLID | ✅ | Catalog + membership grants; UI projects permissions |
| DRY | ✅ | Reuse Library browsers with saga filter |
| Security | ✅ | RLS/RPC enforce; native immutable; URL ≠ auth |
| UI/UX | ✅ | Lobby Peak-End; rename PC tab; Lore tab; no fake stubs long-term |
| Scaling | ✅ | Bindings + grants per saga; no global role explosion |
| Testability | ✅ | Permission unit matrix; lobby e2e create→code visible |
| Maintainability | ⚠️ | Must deprecate `is_project_gm` gradually |

**Confidence: 93%**

| Criterion | Status |
|-----------|--------|
| User intent clarified | ✅ |
| Codebase mapped | ✅ |
| SOTA / evidence sourced | ✅ Browo catalog + repo stubs/048/061 |
| Cross-domain sign-off | ✅ (Maintainability ⚠️ migration) |
| Open blockers | minor: exact binding table shape in implement |

(Not 99%: binding schema + Lore data sources need one implement spike; permission key list may trim in Phase 1.)

## Implementation Sketch

```
Affected paths:
  supabase/migrations/07x_saga_permission_grants.sql   (new) — catalog seed, member_grants, binding.audience
  supabase/migrations/07x_dornhain_full_catalog.sql     (new) — PCs/world/npc/items/quests + party reveals
  scripts/apply-migrations.sh                          — ensure 061+ applied
  src/domains/saga/permissions/*                       (new) — catalog types, hasPermission, bundles
  src/app/project/SagaWorkspaceNav.tsx                 — rename + lore tab
  src/app/shell/routing/routes.ts                      — SagaSectionId += 'lore'
  src/app/project/SagaResourceScreen.tsx               — real sections; remove UNAVAILABLE stubs
  src/app/project/sections/*                           (new) — characters/world/npc/items/quests/lore
  src/app/session/SessionJoin.tsx                      — remove countdown interstitial
  src/app/session/SessionLobbyScreen.tsx               — primary join code + invite
  src/infrastructure/project/project-service.ts        — fix public-id session resolve

New dependencies: none
Estimated scope: Phase 0–1 ~800–1500 LOC; Phase 2–3 larger (seed + settings UI)
Tests: unit permission matrix; e2e create→lobby code; library filter in saga; migration gate
```
